workflow_runs.display_title: Prompt permanently stuck on "Thinking", even after pressing stop and restarting the Codex app

head_commit.message:
fix: harden plugin feature gating (#15104)

Resubmit https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/15020 with correct
content.

1. Use requirement-resolved config.features as the plugin gate.
2. Guard plugin/list, plugin/read, and related flows behind that gate.
3. Skip bad marketplace.json files instead of failing the whole list.
4. Simplify plugin state and caching.
